_comment: Shared chrome / UI text that isn't owned by one page or section - floating toolbar, dialog + alert buttons, accessibility labels, timings. Read via NT_Ui::label() / NT_Ui::aria() / NT_Ui::setting(), and handed to assets/js/ui-kit.js as window.ntUi so NO user-facing word is hard-coded in PHP, JS or CSS. Edit here, never in the code.
_floating_note: The sticky side shortcut. 'side' is left or right. Each button needs a destination: either 'url' (a page) or 'social' (a key from footer.json -> socials, so the number is not repeated in two files). 'icon' is any NT_Icons name. Add a second button back by adding a second entry - it was two on the right, which covered too much of the reading width on a phone.
